content:
One of my favorite Apple TV 4K features—the screensaver—is reportedly set to gain audio in tvOS 27. Here's what we know so far.

tvOS 27 code shows at least one Apple TV screensaver will get an audio option, with more expected to follow.

October is shaping up to be a big month for Apple, with a slew of new hardware and software products expected.

In addition to the rumored new Apple TV 4K, a leaked image of internal Apple code has also surfaced.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just published evidence from the tvOS 27 code showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver will support audio.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to turn audio on or off, or use a "reduce" setting.

The Snoopy screensaver examples don't seem too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users turn the audio off completely.

While pdfu hasn't found other screensavers with audio support yet, there's a good chance Apple will expand this feature to more screensavers.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
